commands.name: list-forces
commands.summary: List all police forces (id and name). Use the id in other commands.

commands.name: get-force
commands.summary: Get one police force's details: website, phone number and engagement channels such as social media.

commands.name: list-force-officers
commands.summary: List the senior officers of a police force, with rank and bio.

commands.name: list-crime-categories
commands.summary: List the crime categories (url slug and name) that were valid for a given month.

commands.name: list-dates
commands.summary: List the months that have street-level data available, and which forces published stop and search data for each month.

commands.name: get-last-updated
commands.summary: Get the date the crime data was last updated (this is the latest month available).

commands.name: street-crimes
commands.summary: Street-level crimes for one month, either within a 1-mile radius of a lat/lng point or inside a custom polygon. Can be limited to one category.

commands.name: crimes-at-location
commands.summary: Crimes recorded at the anonymised location nearest to a lat/lng point, or at a specific street location id, for one month.

commands.name: crimes-no-location
commands.summary: Crimes a force recorded in one month that could not be mapped to a location.

commands.name: outcomes-at-location
commands.summary: Case outcomes recorded in one month near a lat/lng point, at a street location id, or inside a polygon. Each outcome includes the crime it relates to.

commands.name: get-crime-outcomes
commands.summary: Get the full outcome history of one crime, looked up by its persistent_id.

commands.name: list-neighbourhoods
commands.summary: List the neighbourhood policing areas (id and name) of a force.

commands.name: get-neighbourhood
commands.summary: Get one neighbourhood's details: name, centre point, description, links and contact details.

commands.name: get-neighbourhood-boundary
commands.summary: Get a neighbourhood's boundary as a list of lat/lng points. These can be joined as lat,lng:lat,lng for the poly param of other commands.

commands.name: list-neighbourhood-team
commands.summary: List the officers and PCSOs on a neighbourhood's policing team.

commands.name: list-neighbourhood-events
commands.summary: List upcoming events for a neighbourhood, such as police drop-ins and community meetings.

commands.name: list-neighbourhood-priorities
commands.summary: List a neighbourhood's policing priorities: each issue and the action taken on it.

commands.name: locate-neighbourhood
commands.summary: Find which force and neighbourhood cover a lat,lng point.

commands.name: stops-street
commands.summary: Stop and searches in one month within a 1-mile radius of a lat/lng point, or inside a polygon.

commands.name: stops-force
commands.summary: All stop and searches a force reported for one month.

commands.name: stops-no-location
commands.summary: Stop and searches a force reported for one month that could not be mapped to a location.

commands.name: stops-at-location
commands.summary: Stop and searches at a specific street location id for one month.
